TRPM6_TRPM7.structure: Homotetrameric and heterotetrameric divalent cation-permeable channel-kinases
TRPM6_TRPM7.tissue_localization: Enterocyte brush border membrane in duodenum, jejunum, and distal colon; renal distal convoluted tubule
TRPM6_TRPM7.regulatory_mechanisms: Intracellular Mg-ATP negative feedback, EGF stimulation via CNNM4, circadian TRPM6 upregulation during early diurnal activity
TRPM6_TRPM7.clinical_collision_threshold: Luminal molar Ca:Mg ratio exceeding 2:1 blocks TRPM6 mediated active influx by up to 82%, forcing unabsorbed Mg into the colon as an osmotic cathartic agent.

TRPV6.structure: High-affinity, constitutively active Ca2+-selective cation channel
TRPV6.tissue_localization: Apical membrane of duodenal and jejunal enterocytes
TRPV6.regulatory_mechanisms: Transcriptionally activated by 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 [1,25(OH)2D3] binding to the VDR, calbindin-D9k cytosolic buffering
TRPV6.clinical_collision_threshold: Concurrent intake of high-dose calcium citrate (>500 mg) fully saturates TRPV6 binding velocity (Vmax), producing microvillar electrical neutralization that impedes adjacent paracellular magnesium diffusion.

DMT1_SLC11A2.structure: Proton-coupled divalent metal ion symporter (Nramp family)
DMT1_SLC11A2.tissue_localization: Duodenal brush border apical enterocyte membrane
DMT1_SLC11A2.regulatory_mechanisms: Iron-regulatory protein (IRP1/IRP2) binding to 3' iron-responsive element (IRE), hepcidin-mediated ferroportin degradation
DMT1_SLC11A2.clinical_distinction: DMT1 does NOT transport Mg2+ or Ca2+ in physiological conditions. Conflating DMT1 with TRPM6/TRPV6 is a known diagnostic error. DMT1 is dedicated to transition metals.

Claudin_16_19.structure: Heteromeric tight junction pore complex forming cation-selective paracellular channels
Claudin_16_19.regulatory_mechanisms: Lumen-positive transepithelial voltage gradient (+5 to +10 mV) generated by apical Na+/H+ exchangers and basolateral Na+/K+ ATPases
Claudin_16_19.clinical_collision_threshold: High simultaneous osmotic load of calcium and magnesium salts collapses the lumen-positive potential, reducing paracellular flux of both cations by 65-70%.

LAT1_SLC7A5.structure: Sodium-independent, neutral amino acid exchanger (System L) paired with 4F2hc (SLC3A2)
LAT1_SLC7A5.pharmacodynamics: L-Theanine competitively utilizes LAT1 to achieve therapeutic CSF concentrations within 30-45 minutes of oral dosing, antagonizing glutamate NMDA/AMPA receptors and upregulating GABA synthesis.

Slc12a8_NMN_Transporter.structure: Sodium-dependent nicotinamide mononucleotide specific active transporter
Slc12a8_NMN_Transporter.tissue_localization: Small intestine enterocytes, hypothalamus, brain microvascular endothelium
Slc12a8_NMN_Transporter.pharmacodynamics: Translocates NMN intact directly across cellular membranes without requiring prior extracellular CD73 dephosphorylation to nicotinamide riboside (NR), driving systemic NAD+ salvage biosynthesis within 15 minutes.
